project.name: HOLLOW DOMINION
project.author: Nejib / Nejiii38
project.gear_model_policy: Beta non-BiS validates behavior; final model uses best legal 0.5.2 affixes/tiers/rolls after audit.

locked_pillars: Boss Freeze/chill must be quasi-instant and function as part of the opening boss-control cycle.
Cold and Lightning must both be practically usable; Charged Staff cannot remain a theoretical layer blocked by Power Charge friction.
Hollow Form → Whirling Assault remains main boss DPS.
Shattering Palm remains main clearing skill.
Preserve the current build's strong damage, clearing, survivability and boss stun while fixing identity gaps.
identity.optimization_rule: Do not rebuild or denigrate a beta that already performs very well. Fix the Cold/Lightning and boss-Freeze identity gaps without unnecessarily sacrificing validated strengths.

passive_tree.visual_rule: Render deterministically from data.json; hide Weapon Sets; never reconstruct topology with generative image tools.

beta_solution.observed_result: No remaining Mana sustain problem in real beta play.

mana.final_rule: 63/68 are a sufficient beta baseline, not final BiS rolls. Use best legal 0.5.2 rolls on final ring bases and revalidate after relevant speed/cost changes.

hollow_resonance_test_gate.observation: Hollow Resonance is not yet acquired or tested on the beta character.
hollow_resonance_test_gate.rule: All current issues are pre-Hollow Resonance baseline. Do not lock structural corrections before testing Hollow Resonance.

power_charge_economy.observation: Hollow Form is the main observed Power Charge generator but consumes them almost immediately.
power_charge_economy.impact: Charged Staff is too difficult to activate/maintain, making Lightning/Shock setup cumbersome and preventing the intended Cold + Lightning identity from functioning naturally.
power_charge_economy.goal: Make Charged Staff reliably available in the normal rotation without breaking Hollow Form or Charge Regulation.
power_charge_economy.next_if_persistent: Treat as first structural correction after Hollow Resonance test.

freeze_boss.observation: Boss Freeze/chill remains much too slow despite +75% Freeze Buildup and Freezing Mark + Ice Bite II.
freeze_boss.identity_target: Quasi-instant first Freeze/chill as part of the boss-opening control cycle.
freeze_boss.constraint: Shattering Palm remains short setup; Hollow Form remains main boss DPS.

charge_duration.goal: Slightly extend useful charge duration/retention to benefit Charge Regulation and potentially Charged Staff.

shattering_palm_overkill.observation: Clear is already very good but overkill could improve.
shattering_palm_overkill.dependency: Do not blame or replace Rising Tempest before Charged Staff is reliable and Shattering Palm is retested with Lightning active.

clearing_survivability.observation: No deaths in clearing except major gameplay mistakes; preserve Evasion + ES + Wind Dancer.

boss_stun.observation: Boss stun is already very strong and should be preserved during Freeze/charge optimization.

general_damage_and_clear.observation: Current beta already has very good damage and very good clear; optimization is not a rebuild from zero.

critical_strikes.observation: Crits are not visually distinguishable in game; decide via real crit-rate and marginal DPS analysis, not feel.

diagnostic_order: Re-evaluate Power Charges / Charged Staff; if still problematic, treat as first structural identity correction
Re-evaluate boss Freeze and drive it toward quasi-instant opening control
Retest Shattering Palm overkill with reliable Charged Staff, then audit Rising Tempest only if needed
maintenance_policy: Record each significant beta/theorycraft issue in Master Context.
Keep real beta measurements separate from theoretical/final BiS projections.
Never promote hypotheses or beta rolls to locked final facts without validation.
Synchronize Master Context, Knowledge Base, Reasoning Index and affected live/documentation files.
Verify actual hollow-dominion-live branch contents after synchronization.
